slides.say: Planets hold continents, continents hold countries. Deleting one country means copying its whole parent chain.
Updating nested state means copying every object from the change all the way up. That code gets very verbose.
Instead, give each place a list of child IDs, and store every place in one table keyed by ID. Like a database table.

slides.text: Remove a place: update its parent’s childIds and the table. Two levels only.
slides.say: Now removing a place touches only two levels: the parent’s child IDs, and the table that holds the parent.
